definition.sound: Andalusian Gitano song, guitar and dance: a raw, melismatic voice over flamenco guitar, handclaps and footwork in fixed rhythmic cycles.
markers: Andalusian cadence and Phrygian sound (A minor, G, F, E)
12-beat compás cycles marked by palmas handclaps
Strained, melismatic cante with 'ay' laments; rasgueado guitar strums
